subject: effect of legend.position on develop branch

messages.author: d674bddd91c6f700
messages.subject: effect of legend.position on develop branch
parts:
In 0.8.9, this code:

x<-0:10
y<-x^2
d<-data.frame(x,y)
print(ggplot()+ geom_point(data=d,aes(x=x,y=y,colour=factor(x))) + 
opts(legend.position=c(0.2,0.7)))

places the legend as I'd expect.  Using the develop branch, the legend appears right in the middle of the plot, 
regardless of the (x,y) values.  I stepped through ggplot_gtable in plot-render.r and things looked OK.  I poked 
around a bit in gtable_add_grob but it was quickly turning into a research project.  Since the very same code 
behaves differently with 0.8.9 and develop, I don't think I'm doing something wrong, but it wouldn't be the first
time.  Is this how legend.position is supposed to behave?

- Dave
